source.paper: The State / State-Record (inferred from “c-o State-Record” box numbers)

summary: Help-wanted pages from a mid-century daily, photocopied hard. Justified agate liners with an all-caps first word, numbered classification heads, and display ads in light condensed sans that ignore the column grid.

headers.notes: Heavy grotesque in mixed case; the class number sits flush right. Rules above and below.

units.example: IMMEDIATE opening for Man ages 25-45 to do general office...
units.notes: First word in caps, then running text; hanging indent on following lines. Ends with a phone number or a blind box (Box B-244 c-o State-Record).
Employment agency ad: quantity—job—wage lines under light condensed caps sub-heads.

units.example: ATTENTION SCHOOL TEACHERS ... OWEN STEEL CO. Inc.
units.notes: Light condensed sans display, generous size, ruled box.

units.example: REGISTERED NURSES / STAFF DUTY positions available
units.notes: Two columns wide; mixes condensed sans with a bold slab sub-line.

type.look: Heavy geometric/grotesque, like Spartan Heavy or Metro Black
Light tall condensed sans, like Tempo or Bernhard Gothic Light

notes: Heavy photocopy noise; the degraded look itself could be a microfiche filter.
Two identical heads side by side (Female Help Wanted 10) show that heads repeat at column tops.
